description: This file defines a Retrofit API interface and data classes for fetching and handling prayer times from the Aladhan API in an Android Kotlin project.

classes.name: AladhanApi
classes.description: Interface defining the API endpoint for retrieving prayer timings by city, with query parameters for city, country, method, and school.

classes.name: AladhanTimingsResponse
classes.description: Data class representing the response from the Aladhan API, including status code, message, and data payload.

classes.name: AladhanData
classes.description: Contains prayer timings, metadata, and date information included in the API response.

classes.name: AladhanTimings
classes.description: Holds individual prayer time strings (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha).

classes.name: AladhanGregorian
classes.description: Represents the Gregorian date with a specific date string.

methods.name: getTimingsByCity
methods.description: Suspend function to perform GET request to 'timingsByCity' endpoint with city, country, method, and school as query parameters, returning prayer timings.
